mods.name: The Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures Mod
mods.author: Daniel T. Gaming
mods.description:
The Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures was released in 2013. I've always loved the game, and I thought about wanting to create courses using the aesthetics of it. I've recreated the course "Future F-ckballs 2010" in Super Mario Maker (https://supermariomakerbookmark.nintendo.net/courses/FEDE-0000-007E-680E) After knowing how to hack SMM, I wondered what I was gonna do next. And thus, my curiosity began to emerge and thought about what possibilities I have for a new mod. And so, I went with the Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures. The mod itself was a pain to make, since I individually recreated Most of the sprites myself, but the Happy Fun Candy Time (Ground) and Nerd sprites were ripped by the Spriters Resource user, Mario1999562. I had to edit them a bit so they would not only fit the grid of the Super Mario Brothers 3 sprite sheet, but so they could go along with the Small, Super, and Fire thing as well. Buntendo is also working on a Sound pack for it (It's coming soon, because there are some bugs with it that we'll be fixing) and NightYoshi370 is helping with a 3DS port of the mod, which will also be coming soon.

Ground: Happy Fun Candy Time

Underground: Future F-ckballs 2010

Ghost House: A--holevania

Airship: Beat It and Eat It

Castle: Laughin' Jokin' Numbnuts

This mod replaces SMB1's boring Haunted House theme, with a more upbeat, but spooky theme based on Bonneton! If the tileset wasn't enough, you get to listen to some sweet 8-BIT Music by the incredibly talented Tater-Tot Tunes!

mods.name: Unlock All Costumes
mods.author: NobleD4
mods.description:
Hello!

More than 1 year ago I made a mod which allows you to Unlock every Mystery Mushroom on 100 Mario Challenge (Easy mode), uploaded with very few weeks until Nintendo Network servers down.

This is not an update from my previous mod, this is an even easier way to unlock every costume in the game because there's no 100 Mario Challenge on Pretendo Network yet and because is impossible to connect to Nintendo Network ever again.

There are 2 main files I had to modify to make this works:
- CharaMarioTable.Byml
- Boss_CharaMarioAmiiboTable.Byml

The first one has all directories from Mystery Mushrooms 1 to 101, the second one all directories from Mystery Mushrooms 102 to 153.
All credits to the user memoryman3 from gbatemp.net to make possible to modify the second file properly.

You can modify the directories file for 102 to 153 to add more, in the case of this mod were added 154 to 165. Note that those costumes aren't made by me.
All credits to the japanese user princess ripblue from mariomakingmods.github.io website to make it possible.

In both of these files I changed "Rare" value, in "CharaMarioTable.Byml" everything was changed to 0 to be unlocked by default. I tried the same for "Boss_CharaMarioAmiiboTable.Byml" but doesn't works, I also tried with "Rare" value in 4 (Unlockeable with Gnat Attack Minigame in Normal mode) but It doesn't work either, for some reason those values only works with "CharaMarioTable.Byml" file.

Apparently to unlock costumes from "Boss_CharaMarioAmiiboTable.Byml" you must have to be playing on course world, so that's why "Rare" value is 1 for this file.

For Mystery Mushrooms from 1 to 101, you have to load this mod everytime you want to have the costumes because for your save data you haven't unlocked these costumes yet. So this is perfect to make your own levels for Pretendo upload.

So this makes Mystery Mushrooms from 102 to 165 impossible to unlock? No, I added to this mod a "save.dat" file with everything in the game unlocked which instructions to setup with SaveMii Tool.

I hope this will be useful for you and thanks for downloading!

mods.name: Unlock All Costumes on 100 Mario (Easy mode)
mods.author: NobleD4
mods.description:
Hello!

Recently, with Nintendo announcement about they're going to end Wii U and 3DS services, I was thinking about unlock every costume I have left, but I'm sure it would take too long unlocking them normally.

A while ago I found a mod here in this website to Unlock every Mystery Mushroom playing 100 Mario Challenge on Easy Mode uploaded by tee, so I discovered the correct answer to unlock every costume left in these 2-3 weeks remaining. Wait, the download link from there is broken like 5 years ago!

Well that's not a problem for me! Last week I learned how to make my own Mystery Mushrooms and I learned that you can modify "Boss_CharaMarioAmiiboTable.Byml" file to be able to edit any "BossXXX.pack" and "BossStaticXXX.pack" Mystery Mushroom files (Boss000-Boss051). All credits to the user memoryman3 from gbatemp.net to make it possible.

You can modify "CharaMarioTable.Byml" file as well for normal Mystery Mushroom costumes, so inside both "CharaMarioTable.Byml" and "Boss_CharaMarioAmiiboTable.Byml" I changed every "Rare" value from every Mystery Mushroom to 1 to make them unlockeable on 100 Mario Challenge Easy Mode.

I also added custom unlockeable "BossXXX" Mystery Mushrooms (Boss052-Boss063) to fill that empty space from 154 to 165 customes. Note that they're not made by me.
All credits to the japanese user princess ripblue from mariomakingmods.github.io website to make it possible.

This is also my first time uploading a mod to GameBanana, so I'm not sure if it's possible to update the post in case I need it. I hope this will be useful for you and don't forget to use this mod with SDCafiine.
